title: 2 hospitalized after car goes off I-75, overturns during crash - NewsBreak
text: A car overturned after driving off Interstate 75 during a crash in Montgomery County Wednesday evening, according to a Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office sergeant. [DOWNLOAD: Free WHIO-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] Deputies responded to reports of a crash in the northbound lanes of I-75 near Benchwood Road after 5:45 p.m. Upon arrival, they found an overturned Infinity QX-60 on Poe Avenue and a Chevrolet Equinox in the far-left lane on I-75. >>PHOTOS: Injuries reported after crash on Interstate 75 in Montgomery County The sergeant said medics took both drivers to local hospitals for treatment. Information on the extent of their injuries was not immediately available. TRENDING STORIES: A preliminary investigation found that the driver of the Chevrolet experienced a medical emergency while driving on the interstate and went unconscious. To avoid a crash, a 15-year-old passenger took the wheel, the sergeant said. The Chevrolet hit the Infinity, which was also driving north on the interstate. The Infinity went off the right side of the road, through a fence, and across Poe Avenue. The car eventually overturned and hit a utility pole in the 5900 block of Poe Avenue, the sergeant said. As previously reported by News Center 7, authorities shut down I-75 N for nearly an hour. The crash remains under investigation by the sheriff’s office Traffic Services Unit. News Center 7 will continue to follow this story. [SIGN UP: WHIO-TV Daily Headlines Newsletter ]
